title: Effects of UV irradiation on the structural and optical properties of epoxy/dysprosium nanocomposite sheets for possible UV dosimetry and optoelectronic applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26567-26582
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01677K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shittu Abdullahi, Ahmed Alshahrie, Aznan Fazli Ismail, Numan Salah
This study investigates the effects of Dy ions on the structural and optical properties of epoxy sheets. The epoxy/Dy nanocomposites showed UV response, suggesting potential for UV sensing, radiation dosimetry, and optoelectronic applications.
